elements.description: Elements are the tracked substances within each material flow. E1 is always "material" (the physical bulk carrier). E2..EN are independently tracked fractions. The number and names of elements are declared in 0_Configuration.

element.name: material
element.note: Total wet mass. Sum-carrier for all other elements.

element.name: DM
element.note: TC/CC fallback pattern: next((e for e in ("TC","CC") if e in elements), None)

sheet.name: 0_Configuration
sheet.description: Key-value pairs for global model settings. The configuration sheet may also be named "Configuration" or "Config" in older templates (config.py falls back through all three names).

column.name: Value
column.note: Elements value is a comma-separated list, e.g. "material,WC,DM,TC"

sheet.name: 1_1_Definition_Flows
sheet.description: Defines all material flows between processes. Each row is one directed edge in the flow graph.

column.name: Flow_Output_Process_ID
column.note: Source process — the process this flow LEAVES FROM. Named "Output" from the perspective of the source process. Accessed as row["Flow_Output_Process_ID"] throughout the engine.

column.name: Input_Process_ID
column.note: Destination process — the process this flow ENTERS. Named "Input" from the perspective of the destination process. Accessed as row["Input_Process_ID"] throughout the engine.

column.name: E{n}_Fraction[%]
column.note: Fraction of element n in this flow; used for composition tracking.

column.name: Flow_WC_ID
column.note: Legacy reference ID for WC fraction (older templates). Trailing-space variant "Flow_WC_ID " is normalised by COLUMN_NAME_MAPPING.

sheet.code_note: WRONG names sometimes seen in older code: "From_Process", "To_Process" — these do NOT exist in the Excel template. Always use the names above.

sheet.name: 1_2_Data_Flows
sheet.description: Annual flow quantity data. Supports old and new element-column formats.

column.name: E1_value
column.note: Material (E1) flow quantity. New format.

column.name: Flow_Material
column.note: Total material flow (Mg/a). Old format.

column.name: CC_[%]
column.note: Legacy TC column name.

sheet.name: 2_1_Definition_Processes
sheet.description: Defines all processes (nodes) in the MFA system. Process 0 is the system boundary (environment); it is labeled "Input" in the process_logic_map built by system_setup.py.

column.name: ID
column.note: Primary key. The column is named "ID" in the Excel template. system_setup.py accesses it as row["ID"] and set_index("ID"). REQUIRED_STRUCTURE also specifies "ID". WARNING: some data_loader.py validate-only functions mistakenly reference "Process_ID" instead — these silently produce no output but do not break model execution.

column.name: Process_Logic

value.name: Input
value.description: System boundary source — no inflows allowed

value.name: Output
value.description: System boundary sink — no outflows allowed

value.name: Splitter
value.description: Distributes inflow across outflows via TCs. Gets TCs loaded.

value.name: Transformer
value.description: Transforms input composition via TCs. Gets TCs loaded.

value.name: DSM
value.description: Dynamic stock model — cohort accumulation and outflow. Gets TCs loaded.

value.name: BOM_Assembler
value.description: Assembles multiple input flows into one output via BOM fractions.

value.name: Pass-through
value.description: Copies total inflow directly to outflow. No TCs required.

value.name: LFG
value.description: Landfill gas generation model (N-pool FOD, UNFCCC AM-Tool-04).

column.tc_loading_note: TCs are loaded ONLY for Splitter, Transformer, and DSM logic types (data_loader.load_tc_parameters, line ~768). Input, Output, and Pass-through processes are always skipped regardless of their TC_Configuration value.

column.name: TC_Configuration

value.name: Static
value.description: Fixed TCs from 2_2_static_TCs. Required for Splitter/Transformer/DSM.

value.name: Dynamic
value.description: Year-varying TCs from 2_3_dynamic_TCs.

value.name: No TC
value.description: No TCs — for processes that carry the value through unchanged (Pass-through, BOM_Assembler, LFG).

column.convention: Input and Output processes conventionally use TC_Configuration = "Static" in the template (validate_unified_configuration warns if they do not), even though the engine ignores TC_Configuration for these logic types.

column.name: Stock_Configuration

value.name: Stock
value.description: Simple stock accumulation.

value.name: No_Stock
value.description: Flow-through only; no stock variable created.

value.name: Stock_with_InitialStock_Cohort
value.description: Stock with initial cohort distribution (DSM only).

value.name: Stock_with_InitialStock_Decay
value.description: Stock with initial decay model (DSM only).

column.convention: Output processes conventionally use Stock_Configuration = "Stock" so cumulative boundary flows accumulate (validate_unified_configuration warns otherwise). DSM processes must use one of the Stock_with_InitialStock_* variants if initial stock data is provided in 2_4_Initial_Stock.

column.name: Outflow_count
column.note: Nr. of outflows; used for TC sum validation. Mapped from 'Nr. Outflows'.

sheet.name: 2_2_static_TCs
sheet.description: Static (time-invariant) transfer coefficients. Each row defines the fraction of element E{n} that leaves process P via flow F. All TC rows for a given (Process_ID, E{n}) must sum to 1.0. Only loaded for processes with TC_Configuration = "Static" AND Process_Logic ∈ {Splitter, Transformer, DSM}.

column.name: E{n}_TC_ID
column.note: Internal parameter reference ID (e.g. TC_05_06). E1=material included here unlike TC_Value columns.

column.name: E{n}_TC_Value[%]
column.note: E1_TC_Value[%] is NOT independently settable — material follows element fractions.

validation.rule: SUM over all Flow_IDs for same (Process_ID, E{n}) MUST equal 1.0 (±1e-6)
validation.enforcement: BLOCK Apply in systemmanager TC editor

column.name: TC_{element}_ID
column.note: e.g. TC_material_ID, TC_WC_ID

column.name: TC_Value_{element}
column.note: e.g. TC_Value_material, TC_Value_WC

column.name: Outflow_count
column.note: Mapped from 'Nr. Outflows'.

column.name: Titel_source
column.note: Mapped from 'Titel_Source'.

column.name: Author_source
column.note: Mapped from 'Author_Source'.

sheet.name: 2_3_dynamic_TCs
sheet.description: Year-varying transfer coefficients. Same structure as 2_2_static_TCs plus a Year column for time-series interpolation. Only loaded for processes with TC_Configuration = "Dynamic".

column.name: Year
column.note: Only 'Year' is in REQUIRED_STRUCTURE for this sheet.

validation.rule: After time-interpolation, sums per (Process_ID, element) are normalised by normalize_dynamic_tcs_by_process() in data_loader.py to ensure 1.0.

sheet.name: 2_4_Initial_Stock
sheet.description: Initial stock values for DSM processes with cohort or decay initialisation. Referenced when Stock_Configuration ∈ {Stock_with_InitialStock_Cohort, Stock_with_InitialStock_Decay}.

column.name: Initial_Stock_CC[%]
column.note: Legacy TC/CC alias.

sheet.name: 3_1_Definition_DSM
sheet.description: Lifetime distribution parameters for DSM processes.

value.name: Inflow_Split_[%]
value.description: Fraction of total inflow entering this DSM category

value.name: Lifetime_Type
value.description: Distribution: Normal, LogNormal, Fixed, Weibull

value.name: Lifetime_Mean
value.description: Mean lifetime (years)

value.name: Lifetime_StdDev
value.description: Standard deviation of lifetime (years)

value.name: DSM_Lifetime_Scale
value.description: Scale parameter (Weibull/LogNormal)

value.name: DSM_Lifetime_Shape
value.description: Shape parameter (Weibull/LogNormal)

sheet.name: 3_2_Definition_FOMP
sheet.description: FOMP (First-Order Multi-Pool) soil carbon decay parameters per process.

value.name: f_labile
value.description: Labile fraction (0.0–1.0); recalcitrant = 1 − f_labile (the recalcitrant fraction parameter has no effect — hardcoded).

value.name: k_labile
value.description: Labile pool first-order decay rate (yr⁻¹)

value.name: k_recalcitrant
value.description: Recalcitrant pool first-order decay rate (yr⁻¹)

value.name: Nr._Decay_Pools
value.description: Number of pools (currently fixed at 2; single-valued row)

column.name: FOMP_Parameter_Value
column.note: Mapped from legacy 'FOMP_Value'.

sheet.name: 3_3_Definition_BOM_Assembly
sheet.description:
Bill-of-Materials assembly fractions for BOM_Assembler processes. Defines how element fractions are distributed across output flows. Fractions are parent-relative (e.g. WC fraction = % of material; TC fraction = % of DM — see Parent_Element_ID_N in 0_Configuration).
NOTE: shares the "3_3" prefix with 3_3_Definition_LFG — this is a template naming quirk; both sheets coexist in the same workbook.

column.name: Process_ID
column.note: Must reference a process with Process_Logic = BOM_Assembler.

value.name: target_Product
value.description: Primary output flow — receives BOM fraction number inputs in editor.

value.name: Unused_Material
value.description: Remainder flow — automatically receives 1 − Σfractions; no inputs.

column.name: TC_Configuration
column.note: Mirrors TC_Configuration from the process definition row.

column.name: E{n}_TC_Value[%]
column.note: E1 (material) column is not used for BOM fractions — only E2..EN.

validation.rule: SUM over all target_Product rows for same (Process_ID, E{n}) SHOULD be ≤ 1.0
validation.enforcement: WARN in systemmanager BOM editor — do not block; remainder goes to Unused_Material.

sheet.name: 3_3_Definition_LFG
sheet.description:
Landfill gas generation parameters (N-pool FOD, UNFCCC AM-Tool-04). NOTE: shares the "3_3" prefix with 3_3_Definition_BOM_Assembly.
Gas outputs convention: material = DM = TC = TOC = C_mass (Mg C). Multiply CH4-C × 16/12 for Mg CH4.

column.name: Process_ID
column.note: Must reference a process with Process_Logic = LFG.

column.name: LFG_Parameter_ID
column.note: Format: P{id}_{name}, e.g. P5_MCF, P5_k_1

value.name: site_param
value.description: Site-level scalar: MCF, DOCf, F_CH4, OX, phi (φ correction), f_capture

value.name: fraction_param
value.description: Degradable fraction row: k_j, DOC_j, f_input_j, f_ash_j

relationship.name: Flow_leaves_Process
relationship.note: Each flow has exactly one source process.

relationship.name: Flow_enters_Process
relationship.note: Each flow has exactly one destination process.

relationship.name: StaticTC_belongs_to_Process
relationship.constraint: Only for Process_Logic ∈ {Splitter, Transformer, DSM} with TC_Configuration = Static

relationship.name: StaticTC_references_Flow
relationship.constraint: TC Flow_ID must be an outflow of the same Process_ID (Flow_Output_Process_ID = Process_ID)

relationship.name: DynamicTC_belongs_to_Process
relationship.constraint: Only for Process_Logic ∈ {Splitter, Transformer, DSM} with TC_Configuration = Dynamic

rule.description: TC sum per (Process_ID, element) must equal 1.0
rule.formula: SUM(E{n}_TC_Value[%]) over all Flow_IDs for same Process_ID == 1.0 ± 1e-6

rule.description: BOM fraction sum per (Process_ID, element) must not exceed 1.0
rule.formula: SUM(E{n}_TC_Value[%]) over all target_Product rows for same Process_ID ≤ 1.0 + 1e-9
rule.note: Remainder (1 − sum) is automatically routed to Unused_Material.

rule.description: Flow source and destination Process IDs must reference existing processes

Input and Output processes should have TC_Configuration = "Static". (Engine ignores TC_Configuration for these logic types, but template convention is "Static" — validate_unified_configuration warns otherwise.)
BOM_Assembler processes should have at least one Unused_Material outflow row
No pandas duplicate-column suffixes (.1, .2, …) in any sheet
DSM processes should have a valid Stock_Configuration variant; Output processes should have "Stock".

editor_state.description: The systemmanager edits_state overlay stores user changes without mutating the base excel_state. Changes are merged via _apply_edits() only at validation time and on YAML export.

key.name: processes
key.note: pid → {Process_Name, Process_Logic, TC_Configuration, Stock_Configuration} Key is the integer value from the "ID" column.

key.name: tcs
key.note: (process_id, flow_id, "E{n}") → value; "E{n}" uses index notation, not element name

key.name: config
key.note: Reserved for future Model Config editing (not in Phase 3B scope)

state.name: tc_sel_state
state.description: Selected Process ID in TC editor

state.name: bom_sel_state
state.description: Selected Process ID in BOM editor

dirty_state.name: dirty_state
dirty_state.description: True when edits_state has uncommitted changes

yaml_export.description: yaml_schema.model_to_yaml() produces this top-level structure. Element names (not E{n} indices) are used as YAML keys for human-readable, git-diffable output.

key.name: transfer_coefficients
key.note: grouped by process; element names as value keys

key.name: bom_assembly
key.note: target_Product rows get fractions; Unused_Material gets empty dict
